infobox.usage: Unlocks the hillside house on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Hillside house key (House) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens one of the old village houses.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The hillside house is located on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Jacket
- 1x Sport bag
- Loose loot (Provisions, Valuables)
- Military Electronics spawn in the sink (Phased array element, Virtex, etc.)
